key = "SOLVECRYPTO"

# Vigenere decryption: P = (C - K) mod 26
plaintext = ""

    k = key[i % len(key)]
    p = (ord(c) - ord('A') - (ord(k) - ord('A'))) % 26
    plaintext += chr(p + ord('A'))

print(plaintext)
